summary: Restoration pledges include 2,000,000 ha of landscape restoration in ASALs—about 3.1% of Somalia's land area—and 50,000 ha of reforestation/afforestation, equivalent to roughly 1.2% of current forest cover. Conservation combines 120,000 ha of forest conservation (≈2.8% of current forest), 50,000 ha each of sustainable land management and wetland/mangrove degradation reduction, and deforestation/degradation reduction. Agriculture focuses on 50,000 ha of agroforestry (≈0.8% of current agricultural land), 30,000 ha of crop rotation, 20,000 ha of climate-smart agriculture, tillage, rice, irrigation and fodder measures, alongside a 500,000-animal livestock programme, 60,000 tons of improved manure management, technology transfer, and a 50% charcoal-production sustainability/efficiency target. The 2035 mitigation targets include 4.24 Mt CO₂e from agriculture (10.70% relative to BAU) and 19.3 Mt CO₂e, or 57%, from LULUCF; sector passages also cite 5.88 Mt CO₂e for agriculture and 18.10 Mt CO₂e for forestry.

targets.context: Equivalent to ≈1.2% of current forest area (4,263,700 ha)
Target area is ≈3.1% of total land area (63,716,900 ha)
Target area is ≈114% of current wetland area (43,900 ha)

targets.metric: Agricultural GHG reduction relative to BAU
Sustainability and efficiency in charcoal production
Technology transfer and capacity building coverage
LULUCF GHG reduction relative to BAU
